entities.summary: Trevor John Cadieu is a retired senior Canadian military officer. He reached the rank of lieutenant general and was slated to become army commander, but after facing an allegation of sexual assault from nearly 30 years before, and after months of trial delay, took his release from the military. Cadieu maintained his innocence from the start, and encouraged a thorough investigation to expose the truth. In October 2023, the charge was stayed by an Ontario judge, ruling that unreasonable delays in disclosure by military police had violated his Charter rights.
